articles.title: Strategy Swings From $13 Billion Bitcoin Loss to $1.4 Billion Profit as BTC Rallies
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin treasury giant is sitting on roughly $1.4 billion in unrealized gains after Bitcoin climbed above its average acquisition price.

articles.title: Bitcoin Hits Highest Price Since June as $3 Billion in Shorts Liquidated
articles.snippet: Bitcoin punched above $72,000 Thursday, extending a two-day squeeze that's wiped out the most short positions on record and mounted the first real challenge to a bearish chart that's held since November.
